translations.text: He is mighty and fearsome; his judgment comes from himself, and he displays his splendor.
They all come to plunder. Their faces look fierce, and they gather captives like sand.
Because you plundered many nations, the nations that remain will plunder you, because of human bloodshed and violence against the land, the city, and all its inhabitants.
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.
Lord, I heard your name and was afraid. Lord, [?] your works in the midst of the years of life; in the midst of the years you will be known. In wrath, remember your mercy.
The mountains saw you and trembled. A torrent of water swept past; the deep raised its voice and lifted its hands high.
